title: Fauxter needs lyrical assistance

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Hey, it's you! I think it's you. I can't really tell you all apart right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, it's you! I think it's you. I can't really tell you all apart right now.

nodes.text: People. You all kinda blur together. I think we're all reverting back into the energy field that connects us and binds us together. We're all becoming one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People. You all kinda blur together. I think we're all reverting back into the energy field that connects us and binds us together. We're all becoming one.

nodes.text: Hey, thanks for your honesty. That's... very clear.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Ugh. I am. I'm starting to think we're not all so connected anymore. I think we're all separate and alone and we're probably all gonna die like... like REALLY soon. Aren't we?
